data.title: bn-3l8n: adopt the pack snapshot sidecar across apps and tooling
data.description:
Switches every production/example/tooling/test-support path from FjallSnapshotBackend to mess_store::PackSnapshotBackend so bn-fj34 (fjall deletion) is mechanical.

Path convention: <store>/.snapshots.packs/ (new dir, not the old .snapshots/), Buffered save mode everywhere. Old fjall sidecar dirs are ignored, never read/migrated/deleted -- a reopened old store falls back to replay, which is the discardable contract.

Key review points:
1. crates/mess-cli/src/metaread.rs -- app snapshot enumeration now goes through Sidecar::open_reader (no lock, no mutation) + stream_names/load. LiveSnapshot shape deliberately unchanged (stream_id stays the interim FNV id) so doctor/inspect/retention JSON is byte-identical. The meta-store-locked degradation now applies only to the legacy <dir>/meta source.
2. crates/mess-cli/tests/golden.rs + tests/golden/README.md -- goldens are immutable and carry the fjall-era sidecar, so step 6 became a compatibility assertion (the committed sidecar MISSES safely; the read-only open creates no LOCK/IDENTITY) and the state-blob byte assertion moved to step 7 where it is derived from committed payloads. Reviewed compatibility statement in the README.
3. crates/mess-cli/src/backup.rs -- documents the sidecar as a deliberate exclusion from the backup cut (discardable, UUID-scoped).

Evidence: cargo nextest -p mess-store (MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25) 238 passed; -p mess-cli 40 passed; -p social 122 passed; cargo check --workspace --all-targets clean; just fmt-check clean; social --rebuild byte-compare proof PASS against a real seeded store on packs (and PASS again with a stale .snapshots/ dir present, marker file intact).

Out of scope per the lead's ruling: SnapshotCompatibility/SnapshotCoverage public API, scan_snapshots cursors, GC tooling, CertifiedSnapshotRef, million-head certification matrices.
